subject: CloudScale Summit — keynote studio slot & on-site activation details
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@cloudscale.events>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: CloudScale Summit - Mid-tier partner package (studio keynote)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week — excited you are considering CloudScale Summit for Redwood Inference. Attached is the initial mid-tier partner term sheet we usually offer (sponsorship_term_sheet_v1.pdf) which includes a 'Studio Keynote' option we think maps well to your product update narrative. High level:

- Studio Keynote (20 minutes) on the main stage (pre-ticketed studio stream)
- 10x10 booth in Technology Row (booth_map_v3.png attached)
- Logo placement: 3rd tier on main stage backdrop, 2nd tier on lanyards (digital + print)
- Two complimentary tickets + one exhibitor pass for lounge access
- One sponsored session in the student track (optional add-on)

If you want, we can talk through: moving the keynote to a 30-minute slot, additional branding in the green room, and a branded ride-share lounge activation. I can loop in our AV partner (StageCraft) for technical rider details.

Attaching the term sheet and the venue map for your ops team. If these broad strokes look good I can send an updated terms PDF with line items and a DocuSign link.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Director, Partnerships | CloudScale Events
priya@cloudscale.events
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: sponsorship_term_sheet_v1.pdf, booth_map_v3.png

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@cloudscale.events>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudScale Summit - Mid-tier partner package (studio keynote)

Hi Priya — thanks for sending this over. A few quick clarifying items from our side before we proceed:

1) Keynote timing & audience: Is the "Studio Keynote" embedded in the main conference schedule (lot of press/partners) or staged for a concurrent studio stream? We need to understand audience composition & whether the talk will be available on-demand.

2) Speaker slot length: Can the 20-minute studio keynote be increased to 30 minutes (including 5 minutes for Q&A)? We are planning to demo performance metrics live and need a brief Q&A.

3) Logo assets & placement: Please confirm the exact pixel size and prominence for the stage backdrop vs. lanyards. Also we prefer 2-tier on the stage backdrop if possible.

4) AV / pre-recorded content: Our comms team may want to pre-record a short branded B-roll for the studio feed — can StageCraft accept pre-recorded assets and mix live demo + pre-record?

5) Exclusivity & competing sponsors: Would Redwood be exclusive in the "observability/serving/runtime" category for the studio keynote?

If you can answer these I can circulate to Marketing and Ops and give you a yes/no timeframe. Also send the updated terms with the line items and invoicing milestones.

Cc'ing Rachel (marketing lead) to confirm activation asks and Monica (events operations) for logistics.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 503-555-0110

From: Priya Sharma <priya@cloudscale.events>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudScale Summit - Mid-tier partner package (studio keynote)

Hi Marcus — apologies for the delay, pulled together answers and an updated terms PDF (cloudscale_updated_terms_v2.pdf) with alternate line items. Summary below: 

- Studio Keynote: 25-minute slot on main stage with studio-stream — 20 minutes talk, 5 minutes live Q&A. The session will be recorded and available on demand for 6 months.
- Booth placement: Technology Row B12 (highlighted in updated map). We can upgrade to a 10x20 for an additional $6,000.
- Logo: Stage backdrop third-row (logo width approx 420px at 72dpi when printed); lanyard logo will be reduced, but we can include a 2nd-tier logo on the LED sponsor wall during sponsor breaks (digital rotation).
- AV & pre-record: StageCraft can mix pre-recorded b-roll and live demo. Looping in Ethan from StageCraft (CC). AV rider attached (AV_rider_stagecraft.docx).
- Category exclusivity: We can offer non-exclusive rights by default; exclusivity for 'model serving/runtime' category can be granted as a contract add-on for +$12,000 (limits one direct competitor).

If you want the 30-minute slot we can do 30 (25 talk + 5 Q&A) as a special request if we shift some sponsor panels — would require confirmation by July 15 to hold the extra 5 minutes.

I can send a DocuSign package that codifies the final deliverables, invoicing schedule (50% due on signature, remainder 30 days prior) and the add-on line for exclusivity.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Director, Partnerships | CloudScale Events

Attachments: cloudscale_updated_terms_v2.pdf, AV_rider_stagecraft.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@cloudscale.events>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudScale Summit - Mid-tier partner package (studio keynote)

Priya — thanks, that helps. Internal notes (forwarding):

- Marketing ask: Push for 30 minutes (25 min live + 5 Q&A) if we can get it without moving into premium pricing. A 30-minute demo lets us include a short benchmark walkthrough and customer quote. Also request: 2 minute pre-roll with Redwood logo before the session stream and a 60-second sponsor highlight in the event trailer.
- Ops ask: Confirm green room branding (logo on green room wall) and one dedicated AV tech during rehearsals. Also request power drop and two dedicated ethernet lines at booth B12; if they can't accommodate we may require a 10x20.
- Legal/commercial: Exclusivity is important — can we get a limited exclusivity for "model serving/runtime" from the point of sale through event end for the +$12k add-on? That seems reasonable. Please confirm the invoicing/milestone language in the updated terms so Finance can book it.

Marcus (to Priya): Can you confirm the following in the DocuSign: 30-minute slot hold if we sign by July 15, green room branding, one pre-roll placement and the exclusivity add-on line at +$12,000? Also please include StageCraft's estimated AV uplift for a 30-minute live demo.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Sharma <priya@cloudscale.events>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Brooks <ethan@stagecraftav.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Final terms & DocuSign for CloudScale Summit — Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus — great to align. We were able to hold the extra 5 minutes and StageCraft provided the AV uplift estimate. Final items we've codified in the DocuSign package: 

- Studio Keynote: 25 minute talk + 5 minute live Q&A (30 min total) — recorded and VOD for 6 months
- Pre-roll: one 120-second pre-roll with Redwood logo ahead of the studio stream and a 60-second sponsor highlight in the conference trailer
- Green room branding: Redwood logo on green room wall and one branded table cloth
- Booth: B12 (10x10). Option to upgrade to 10x20 pre-event for $6,000.
- AV: StageCraft will supply one dedicated tech for rehearsals + day-of. AV uplift for the 30-min demo: $2,800 (itemized in AV_rider_stagecraft.docx).
- Exclusivity: Granted for 'model serving/runtime' category for +$12,000; contract language notes limitations and a single competing sponsor exception.
- Payment: 50% on signature, 50% 30 days prior to event. Invoice and DocuSign here: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123456

I've attached the final PDF (cloudscale_updated_terms_v2.pdf) and the AV rider again. If this matches, sign the DocuSign and we'll issue the invoice. Looking forward to seeing Redwood on stage — speaking slot confirmed once signature is received.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Director, Partnerships | CloudScale Events
priya@cloudscale.events

Attachments: cloudscale_updated_terms_v2.pdf, AV_rider_stagecraft.docx
